items.title: Why Trane Technologies (TT) Is Up 6.0% After Boosting 2026 Guidance And Completing $1.07 Billion Buyback
items.summary: In July 2026, Trane Technologies reported second-quarter 2026 results showing higher sales and net income year over year, raised its full-year 2026 revenue and earnings guidance, and disclosed completing a US$1.07 billion share repurchase program covering 2,418,532 shares. The combination of upgraded 2026 guidance, improving earnings per share and continued buybacks highlights management’s confidence in the company’s near-term operating performance and capital allocation approach.
